group: Hub Anchor selections carried as awards at $1
why: RCJ files all 27 ToRCH Care Hub Anchors as Tier 3 award records, each with an amount of $1. They are organisations SELECTED TO CONVENE a hub. DSS's own FAQ: 'Hub Anchors will not act as the fiscal agent' (Q36); its release: participation is 'subject to execution of a Hub Anchor Participation Agreement'. No dollar figure is attached to the role anywhere. 14 of the 27 are hospitals or health systems on the name rule and 11 more carry §8's standing fallback, so believed at face value this publishes at least 14 named hospitals as RHTP recipients with no money behind any.
